name: Preety Bora

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Preety Bora is a poet from Golaghat, Assam, who writes in English and Assamese. She began writing during her college years and has contributed to journals including Setu and GloMag. She also co-edited the bilingual poetry anthology Hejar Kabir Xopoon, Part 1. Her contributor notes describe nature as an enduring source of inspiration.

In “The Pain”, the shrill of cicadas and the sun’s golden light surround a speaker caught in private memories. The lively afternoon cannot dislodge old grief; images of wings, a blue horizon and moonlight nevertheless open a space for imagination. The poem lets the outer landscape and the inner life remain in uneasy conversation.
